shortDescription: Commander, we are off to battle together again. However, we have a problem. Blanford's Grenadiers have spoiled the party and I am trying to get my cadet lance out of the line of fire. I need you to help me cover them and get the kids to safety.
longDescription: No pressure here, Commander, just our reputation with the Blue Star Irregulars is all.
missionSuccessStatementOverride: You saved the cadets, but we lost General Troy. Mona would salute your efforts for her people.
badFaithStatementOverride: You have dishonoured both yourself and the Blue Star Irregulars.
goodFaithStatementOverride: You did your best, but that was not enough to save those kids.
